title: Goat Water Intake Change by Tag
dataSources: Hive metrics (`flowhive:reading`), egg counter events (`eggcounter:event`), goat RFID visits (`goattag:scan`), goat watering and feed logs (`goatcare:event`), and compost readings (`compost:reading`).
app: Smallholding and backyard telemetry from Flow Hive scales, chicken coop counters, RFID goat tags, compost thermometers, and camera-driven chore logs sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=goatcare:event
| search event_type="water" water_l=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(water_l) as water_l by _time goat_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks goat water intake over time and breaks it out by goat.
value: Daily water change is one of the fastest low-effort indicators that an animal's routine has shifted.
implementation: Send goat water intake events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of goat water intake by goat.
grandmaExplanation: It builds how goat water intake changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
